plugins.name: tehik-dev-skills
plugins.description: Core development lifecycle skills for implementing features, fixing bugs, refactoring, managing git, database migrations, dependencies, and codebase quality.

plugins.name: tehik-task-board
plugins.description: Folder-based task board pipeline skills for turning business briefs into tasks, processing queues, running task workflows, and second-pass validation.

plugins.name: tehik-standards-validation
plugins.description: Validate a software project against TEHIK's published standards documents. Each skill splits its source document across parallel subagents to keep context manageable and produces a Markdown audit report with per-requirement verdicts and recommendations. Currently ships validate-tehik-nfr (non-functional requirements).
